rachael_docs: heads up  nightly docs build: console/observability/examples/dashboard-export.json failed parse: unknown field "traceKey" in dashboard widget.
omar_sdk: weird, we merged a change that normalized to snake_case `trace_key` last sprint. maybe someone exported an example from an older UI.
rachael_docs: yeah the file has a pasted dashboard export sample and a Go SDK snippet below that still calls `client.RenderTraceHook(ctx, opts)` which was renamed -> `client.RenderTraceSpan` in sdk v0.9.0.
marvin_ci: [ci/docs] build failed 1749501289  jsonschema error: unknown field 'traceKey' in sources/console/observability/examples/dashboard-export.json
viv_prod: two separate fixes then: rename JSON field in the export + update Go snippet. can you paste the offending lines?
rachael_docs: for JSON:
```
"widgets": [
  {
    "type": "trace",
    "config": {
      "traceKey": "trace.id",
      "display": "latency_vs_cost"
    }
  }
]
```
should be "trace_key": "trace.id".
rachael_docs: Go snippet:
```
if err := client.RenderTraceHook(ctx, cfg); err != nil {
  return err
}
```
should be `RenderTraceSpan(ctx, cfg)` (signature unchanged).
omar_sdk: i'll open a micro-PR to patch both files and add a short note in console/observability/migration.md explaining the JSON key change + SDK rename.
omar_sdk: PR #4127 opened  updates dashboard-export.json, console/observability/examples/snippets/go/trace_render.go, adds comment `# legacy: traceKey -> trace_key` and CHANGELOG docs entry.
marvin_ci: [ci/docs] lint warning 1749501338  noticed a broken link in migration.md pointing to infra/schema#99 (404).
rachael_docs: yeah that link changed after infra repo reorganized. i'll replace with the canonical issue URL and add a redirect note.
omar_sdk: also added a tiny grep-based smokecheck in scripts/docs_smoke.sh to fail on "traceKey" occurrences; left a TODO to improve to a JSON linter that checks allowed keys.
viv_prod: can we also add a short blurb in the Top-level migration guide so users know to update exported dashboards from pre-v0.9? PMs will appreciate the heads-up.
rachael_docs: will do. updating migration.md now and pushing to the PR.
marvin_ci: [ci/docs] build passed 1749501399 :tada:
viv_prod: LGTM, merge when ready. thanks for the quick turnaround.
rachael_docs: merged. added follow-up issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/435 to track other exported dashboard key mismatches across examples.
